propositions: Project routing overlays cannot currently extend built-in overlay trigger vocabulary; registry functions read only committed routing and hardcoded patterns.
The mechanism must allow projects to add trigger_tokens (literal substrings for diff matching) and applies_to globs to built-in overlay IDs, unioning with committed definitions.
A new helper function project_trigger_extensions() must read project overlay entries directly to avoid replace semantics of effective_routing, preserving its threshold/posture role.
glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays must consume project trigger extensions via union, with repo_root threaded from workflow_ops.overlay_union.
Malformed project entries (non-list tokens, non-string values, unknown overlay IDs) must be silently ignored without raising exceptions.
